description: This file defines a PHP class 'ADODB_sybase_ase' which extends 'ADODB_sybase' to provide database interaction methods specific to the Sybase ASE database system. The class includes methods for retrieving table, database, and column metadata, as well as managing stored procedures and error messages. It also includes a subclass 'adorecordset_sybase_ase' for handling recordsets in Sybase ASE context.

classes.name: ADODB_sybase_ase
classes.description: A class extending ADODB_sybase to handle Sybase ASE database interactions, including metadata retrieval for tables, columns, and databases, as well as error handling.

classes.name: adorecordset_sybase_ase
classes.description: A subclass of ADORecordset_sybase tailored for Sybase ASE recordsets, with configuration for database type.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves a list of table or view names from the database, optionally filtered by type.

methods.name: MetaDatabases
methods.description: Returns a list of database names available on the server.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Fetches column metadata for a specified table.

methods.name: getProcedureList
methods.description: Stub function returning false, indicating no procedure list retrieval implemented.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns an error message related to missing Sybase PHP module or propagates parent class error message.
